text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The earlier race was excellent.
Everyone should 
recognize you as one of the strongest
now. How about being a little proud of
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No……not yet. I want to prove that the 
blood flowing through me is the
『Strongest』

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see your enthusiasm hasn't changed much
since your school 
days. I suppose that's just a part of you,
Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're going to train some more after this,
right? 
Since it's been a while,
how about some parallel running?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……! However, aren't you really busy……?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not so much that I can't afford to spend
some time with my esteemed disciple.
Let's just go get changed. 
You want as much time to run as possible,
right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I may not be like my mother,
but I still want to prove I can be 
a role model for you.
Don't hesitate to rely on me, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Groo-nee……there's no way you aren't like
Teacher. 
Your presence is always huge.
The same as always.

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's senpai! Listen to this～.
I had another late start…… 
Though, if I don't make a mistake I win!

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text:
Me too, in the end,
my last push just wasn't enough…… 
a nose,
it was just by a nose!
It's so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I get it,
I get it. I'll take a look at your running too.
So that 
things work out next time,
we'll formulate some countermeasures.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Waaa……today too,
she's surrounded by so many.
It's amazing……
choice_data_list: Cesario, you admire Air Groove too?
Cesario, you admire Air Groove too?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To see her putting in so much effort
to help her 
kouhai like that,
that makes her a great role model to me.

That made sense to me.
Air Groove also ran in the Tiara rotation,
an Uma Musume that achieved 
spectacular success,
including winning the 『Oaks』

She also acts as the Student Council Vice
President so I've 
seen her speaking on stage several times.
On the school grounds,
she always seemed to be surrounded by
people.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A great athlete doesn't necessarily
become a great instructor.
But……the admiration that comes 
from being a great athelete is definitely
a plus.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove became a second generation winner
at the 『Oaks』. From mother to child,
that run was 
inherited.
It kind of gives credence to that.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And that, on campus,
she's always surrounded by so many 
because she can provide the kind of guidance
they need.
choice_data_list: You want to become like that, right?
You want to become like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To be earnest and sincere to everyone.
In 
that way, passing on that run to someone,
crossing 
generations, from one to the next,
and the next.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even if that dream is just a small one,
when all of those dreams come together,
they become one big 
dream.
I think that……is a really wonderful thing!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of grand dream that I'm
willing 
to devote my life to, to see it realized.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The girl that I raise to race, that her 
successor will also leave a mark――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just as the streams in the shadows of
mountains become 
rivers and flow in to the ocean. They connect,
and grow,
and carry these feelings beyond the
horizon.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to be part of the foundation for the
future. Even as 
this body reaches adulthood……and even as it
begins to wither.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That is……to become 『A guiding light for
future Uma Musume』―― 
what I'm willing to spend a lifetime to
accomplish.

I could feel my heart pounding in my chest
again.

Crossing generations,
the inheritance of an Uma 
Musume. Connecting the past to the future,
as if flowing downstream in to a distant
ocean.

The sheer scale of it made my head spin. 
Cesario was looking far beyond the present,
in to the future.

"As a squash is before ’tis a peascod,
or a codling 
when ’tis almost an apple"――How could one
not be 
overwhelmed by the prospects of a girl like
her?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am aware it's an amazing dream.

She had mentioned many times that she wanted
to win the 
Triple Tiara,
especially the 『Oaks』 to prove her worth.

Rather than for a leader,
this was the first step to 
become a 『Guiding Light』.
In order to realize that, 
she would need to take strong and steady
steps forward.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's as you say. 
That's why……I want to carefully choose my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It won't be enough just to guide me to prove
my worth in races. 
For my dream――I need someone who will
accompany me the entire way.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If I had to put it to words, a 『Partner』,
someone to walk 
this path together throughout life.
Someone that makes me 
believe they will be that person,
is who I want as my trainer.

Even after parting ways with Cesario, 
my heart was still beating loudly.

The sun was setting behind the buildings, 
night was approaching from the east.
In to 
that night,
I wish I could toss aside this longing.
choice_data_list: (But here, it was as bright as midday)

text_block_list.text:
……But,
now wasn't the time to be feeling like a
character in a play.
I needed to think about what I could do for
Cesario.

What was the essence of a 『Partner』?
What kind of 
person should the trainer standing next to
Cesario be?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…………Dura,
your growth is quite remarkable……

As I slowly gazed down in to the courtyard,
Air Groove appeared.
The appearance of an unexpected character 
seemed like providence,
turning tragedy to comedy.
choice_data_list: If it's her……then she might know!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're……the trainer that was together with
Cesario. 
What do you need that has you so out of
breath?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Cesario's predecessor? Me?
choice_data_list: You might know what Cesario is thi...
You might know what Cesario is thi...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…………sounds like you've got some circumstances.
Got it. 
For now,
I'll listen to what you have to say.
